_comment: sim-cart-side-bay-v1 (captain option 1, follow-up to sim-shelf-staging-v1 / PR 274): park the rollwagen in a SIDE BAY off the portal axis near the shelf, so both the free robot AND the re-coupled train can pass the single 2.6 m doorway. EXTENDS the shelf_staging opt-in: set BOTH top-level 'shelf_staging': true AND 'cart_side_bay': true, and provide mission_poses.cart_side_bay (the off-axis bay robot pose). Absent cart_side_bay => the sim-shelf-staging-v1 on-axis staging behaviour (byte-identical). Merge the navigation.tow_lanes/directional_zone keys into the mission runtime-config navigation block and the mission_poses entries into mission_poses. Poses are map-frame [x, y, yaw] in metres/radians; yaw PI = facing -x (west), 0 = +x (east), -PI/2 = -y (south), +PI/2 = +y (north).
_transfer_place_target_note: sim-service-place-target-v1: this fragment is the NAV half (outbound tow + side-bay park). The TRANSFER PLACE target for the service leg is the sales-floor ENDCAP, carried in docs/examples/service-leg-carry-mission-fragment.json (transfer_shelf_location / transfer_ground_truth / verify_ground_truth). Do NOT merge the legacy fm461 BACKROOM transfer_ground_truth.target with shelf_staging on -- twin.restock.transfer_place_target now refuses the boot by name (coldwinint1).
_design_note: sim-cart-side-bay-v1 design (CPU-proven, data/sim-cart-side-bay-v1/report.md), dock moved by sim-collect-dock-reach-v1. The cart is docked at the REACHABLE south dock [-4.6, 16.0, -PI/2] (cart deck place target 1.155 m from the fixed collect pose -5.73,16, inside the ~1.3 m arm reach gate -- the gate coldwin26 overran at the old on-axis dock -3.875,15.77, failing the collect place 'unreachable or undersized target'). The OUTBOUND couples there and tows the COUPLED train with a GENTLE curve in the OPEN BACKROOM (peak |articulation| 11.4 deg at y~14.6, away from the door) onto the x=-4.3 portal/bay axis, crosses the doorway ALIGNED (cart ~0.4 deg, 0.54 m west / 1.38 m east clearance in the 2.6 m opening) after a 3.74 m straight lead-in, and tucks it into the south-facing SIDE BAY at robot pose [-4.3, 6.95, -PI/2] -- the cart parks centre ~[-4.3, 8.22], WHOLE-LANE coupled articulation 11.4 deg (< the 15 deg target), vs the ~46 deg of the old coupled-to-endcap lane. There the train BRAKES + RELEASES the cart (reusing the uncouple mechanic) and the free base services the endcap ALONE (sim-service-leg-carry-v1 carry, re-targeted to the bay park). With the cart parked OFF the portal axis, the free base's grid-A* home route through the single 2.6 m doorway now ROUTES (the exact case that found NO PATH with PR 274's on-axis staging cart at [-3.875, 9.27]) -- so on RETURN the robot drives HOME EMPTY through the freed doorway and the cart stays parked (uncoupled) in the side bay. scripts/check_cart_side_bay.py + scripts/check_tow_lanes.py are the CPU proofs; scripts/check_collect_dock_reach.py proves the dock satisfies BOTH the collect place reach AND the gentle outbound at once (data/sim-collect-dock-reach-v1/report.md).
_recouple_note: The free base can RE-COUPLE to the parked cart by reversing STRAIGHT along the cart's drawbar axis onto the hitch (captain-approved coupling shape); the swept base rectangle along that reverse clears the static map (check_cart_side_bay recouple_straight_reverse_clears). The parked cart's drawbar axis is ~[-4.3, 6.95] heading ~-90 deg (south-aligned, from the reachable-dock lane); recouple_standoff_m is how far back along that axis the base stages before the reverse insert. The fine-dock servo (fine_dock.standoff_from_cart) seats the base on the MEASURED cart axis at GPU time, so the exact angled park is tolerated.
_coupled_tow_home_followup_note: THE COUPLED TOW-HOME (cart retrieved to the backroom cart_parking) is a NAMED, CONFIG-SELECTABLE FOLLOW-UP, not in this baseline -- it is kinematically over-constrained on this single-doorway floor and the captain is choosing how to resolve it (see data/sim-cart-side-bay-v1/report.md). A single doorway + a forward-only rear-hitch drawbar forces a CONSERVED ~180 deg cart reorientation on the cramped sales floor; it cannot be gentle on BOTH legs. MEASURED either/or (CPU, real planner): (SOUTH-faced bay, this baseline) gentle 14.4 deg outbound BUT the coupled tow-home must flip the cart ~180 deg -> the authored return route loops 3.8x (fails the check_tow_lanes loop<=1.7 gate) and guided U-turns do not expand (no room between the gondolas); (WEST-faced bay, dock-align shape) a clean return (loop 1.09, 45.6 deg via the y=6 aisle) BUT a 45.9 deg OUTBOUND (the captain's original PR-274 complaint). To add the coupled tow-home once the captain picks: set top-level 'cart_tow_home': true and add the return lane below to navigation.tow_lanes (option C = west bay: change mission_poses.cart_side_bay to the west-facing endcap pose [-3.05, 6.0, PI] and use the return_side_bay_to_cart_parking lane; option B = south bay reorient-in-aisle needs a wider aisle = dataset regen, out of scope here). The runtime RETURN then re-couples at the bay (reuse the couple + uncouple_on_return mechanics) instead of driving home empty. This keeps the follow-up a small diff.

_followup_return_lane_west_bay.name: return_side_bay_to_cart_parking
_followup_return_lane_west_bay._note: west-bay (option C) coupled tow-home: loop_ratio 1.09, peak 45.6 deg, crosses the doorway ALIGNED (throat 0.6 deg). Only valid when cart_side_bay is the west-facing endcap pose.

_gpu_acceptance_note: GPU proof is coldwin25 (integration-owned). Keep the sim-shelf-staging/sim-portal-widen scene keys: portal_floor_box=true and the coupled_heading_hold / heading_hold_prethroat_m / heading_hold_launch_m keys (docs/examples/throat-momentum-launch-mission-fragment.json), unchanged by this geometry change. ACCEPTANCE (baseline, this fragment): the coupled train couples south-aligned on the portal axis, tows STRAIGHT to the side bay (<=15 deg coupled articulation EVERYWHERE, cart crosses the doorway aligned <=10 deg, >=0.5 m clearance each side), uncouples there; the free base services the endcap (carton carried) AND drives HOME EMPTY through the freed doorway (the cart stays parked in the side bay). For the coupled tow-home follow-up, add the return lane per _coupled_tow_home_followup_note and re-run with cart_tow_home=true (coldwin25: full cycle, re-couple at the bay, cart parked home, coupled max articulation reported, cart never angled in the doorway).
